blocks.text: Safavieh’s Invista rugs are made with enhanced polypropylene and high bulk polyester for easy-care beauty. Their contemporary style ensures seamless integration into many transitional room styles. These rugs are power-loomed for durability and clarity of design.

items: Contemporary design is a stylish addition to any room of the home
Refined power-loomed construction ensures an easy-care and virtually non-shedding rug
Made from enhanced premium polypropylene and polyester fibers providing both comfort and durability
Medium 0.5-inch pile height for a sleek look and support underfoot
Safavieh has been a trusted brand and leader in home furnishings for over 100 years, providing quality craftsmanship, unmatched style and the latest trends
